data_output.description: The fixed training command must emit predictions_valid.npz at the requested output path with exactly two arrays: row_ids and scores. row_ids must equal int64 validation positions in canonical validation row order, and scores must be a finite one-dimensional array of identical length. Ground-truth labels must not be loaded or written by the model component; they are owned exclusively by the fixed evaluator.

model_input.description: Model.__init__(dimension, learning_rate, l2) and Model.step(features, labels) must remain compatible with the existing trainer. features is an integer array shaped (batch_size, 5), with the encoded user ID at column 0 and user/item/tab/hour/weekday fields represented through offset IDs. labels is a float array containing binary outcomes. Implement BPR-only within-user pairwise optimization by forming positive-negative pairs among rows sharing the same encoded user ID; do not use pointwise BCE, add features, alter sampling budget, or access validation ground truth. Model.predict(features) must retain its existing one-dimensional score interface and deterministic validation-row alignment.
